column2: ,The original runs RemoveNoRoomObject and the +0x90 unlink only inside `if (v5)`, i.e. only for an ObjectHandle that resolves to a GameObject (recovered/native/hexrays-all/chunk_003.c:11761-11788)
column3: the reconstruction hoists both calls out of that guard, so an unresolvable handle still scans (and, for a null entry, erases from) the no-room list and the list at +0x90, which the original skips. Same function, same root cause: the later `unk_2fc` test is likewise null-guarded in the port where the original dereferences the object unconditionally. Only reachable with a stale/empty handle whose id is still in m_objectMap, so the gameplay effect is confined to that edge case."
